description:
FILED s473t2 (Opus triage of the 152 causeless blessed sweep rows), on main 0d783d24.
Source: perl-tests/caller.t 160-230 and 375-395.

ROWS BEHIND IT: perl-tests/caller.t 30, 31 ("@DB::args doesn't leak with $^P = 0/1"),
32 ("caller does not leak @DB::args elems when AvREAL"), 34 ("caller dies with tie
@DB::args"), 35 ("@DB::args is still tied"), 65 ("no freed scalars") = 6 rows.

PERL'S RULE: inside package DB (or with $^P set), a `caller(N)` call fills
@DB::args with the arguments of the frame it reports.  perl also has two
defensive behaviours the rows test: it dies "Cannot set tied @DB::args" if the
array is tied, and it must not leave freed SVs in the array.

PCL: caller() never touches @DB::args, so
  - row 34's eval does not die and row 35's `tied @args` is false (that half is
    also #155, tie on an ARRAY);
  - row 65 reads `$DB::args[0]` / `[1]` as 'fwib=ARRAY(0x1)' and '' where perl
    reads '' and 'B';
  - rows 30/31/32 additionally need DESTROY at refcount zero
    (docs/not-supported.md '`DESTROY` called by garbage collector'), so they
    cannot pass on this alone.

Related but NOT this: #233 (caller() fidelity family) owns the frame CONTENTS.
This is the separate @DB::args side channel.
subject: BUG: `@DB::args` is never populated by `caller()` -- 6 blessed rows in perl-tests/caller.t, and the whole perl-debugger argument protocol is absent
